definitions.gloss: meeting minutes; minutes; record of proceedings
definitions.explanation: A written record of discussions, decisions, and action items from a meeting. An essential business document for documenting what was discussed and agreed upon.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{議事録|ぎじろく}を{作成|さくせい}する。
{議事録|ぎじろく}を{参加者|さんかしゃ}{全員|ぜんいん}に{送|おく}る。
examples.english: Send the minutes to all the participants.

examples.japanese: {前回|ぜんかい}の{議事録|ぎじろく}を{確認|かくにん}しましょう。
examples.english: Let's review the minutes from the last meeting.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{議事|ぎじ} (proceedings, agenda) + {録|ろく} (record)

TYPICAL CONTENTS:
- {日時|にちじ} - date and time
- {場所|ばしょ} - location
- {出席者|しゅっせきしゃ} - attendees
- {議題|ぎだい} - agenda items
- {決定事項|けっていじこう} - decisions made
- {次回|じかい}アクション - next actions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議事録|ぎじろく}を{作成|さくせい}する - to create minutes
- {議事録|ぎじろく}を{取|と}る - to take minutes
- {議事録|ぎじろく}を{配布|はいふ}する - to distribute minutes
- {議事録|ぎじろく}を{承認|しょうにん}する - to approve minutes

ROLE IN MEETINGS:
The person who takes minutes is called {議事録係|ぎじろくがかり} or {書記|しょき}.

FORMAL VS INFORMAL:
- {議事録|ぎじろく} - formal minutes (official meetings)
- メモ/ノート - informal notes
